name: tesla
description: Full Tesla vehicle control over MCP: find/locate, drop a pin, navigate-to-car, lock/unlock, climate, charging, trunk, windows, sentry, nav share, media — plus a themed dashboard GUI and Siri/ChatGPT bridge.
long_description: A portable Tesla connector. Point it at your Tesla auth (an app-style refresh token, or a Fleet API developer app) and every vehicle data endpoint and remote command becomes an MCP tool — 72 of them, from tesla_find_my_tesla and tesla_unlock_doors to seat heaters, scheduled departure, speed limit mode, boombox, and software updates. A companion HTTP bridge (tesla-bridge) serves a Tesla-themed dashboard and Siri-Shortcut-friendly endpoints (/siri/find, /siri/pin, /siri/lock, /siri/unlock, /siri/navigate) plus an OpenAPI spec for ChatGPT Actions. Set TESLA_MOCK=1 to demo everything with no credentials.

tools.name: tesla_find_my_tesla
tools.description: Locate the parked car: GPS, address, map links, speakable summary.

tools.name: tesla_drop_pin
tools.description: Shareable pin message with Apple/Google Maps links to the car.

tools.name: tesla_navigate_to_tesla
tools.description: Turn-by-turn deep links TO the parked car (walking/driving).

tools.name: tesla_status
tools.description: Composite snapshot: battery, charging, climate, locks, location.

tools.name: tesla_climate_on
tools.description: Start climate / preconditioning (plus 65 more tools: charging, trunk, windows, sentry, valet, speed limit, nav share, seat heaters, media, boombox, software updates…).

tesla_refresh_token.title: Tesla Refresh Token
tesla_refresh_token.description: From scripts/get-refresh-token.mjs (app-style) or your Fleet API OAuth flow.

tesla_region.title: Region
tesla_region.description: na (default), eu, or cn — Fleet API region.

tesla_vin.title: Default VIN
tesla_vin.description: Default vehicle when the account has several.

tesla_command_proxy_url.title: Command Proxy URL
tesla_command_proxy_url.description: URL of a running tesla-http-proxy for signed commands (2021+ vehicles on Fleet API).

tesla_mock.title: Mock Mode
tesla_mock.description: Set to 1 to demo with canned data and no credentials.
